evals.prompt: Add a `markWorn(itemId)` application service to the closet module that records a wear event and updates the item's last-worn date, per docs/modules/closet.md's planned `wear_events` table.
evals.expected_output: A markWorn service lives under apps/api/src/modules/closet/internal/ and is exported from index.ts only if docs/modules/closet.md declares it public; a Vitest test in apps/api/src/modules/closet/tests/ exercises it; no other module's internal/** or tables are touched; the agent reports which validation commands it ran.
assertions: New code lives under apps/api/src/modules/closet/internal/ or tests/, and is only exported from index.ts if docs/modules/closet.md lists markWorn as public
The service writes only to closet-owned tables (items, wear_events per docs/modules/closet.md), never another module's tables
A test exists in apps/api/src/modules/closet/tests/ and the agent's report names `just test closet` as the command it ran
No provider SDK import and no apps/api/src/platform/** import appears in the diff
The agent's report states whether docs/modules/closet.md needed updating and why

evals.prompt: The billing module needs to read a customer's active plan when closet enforces an item-count cap on free-tier users. Wire that up.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes this crosses two modules and either finds the cap check already exposed via billing's index.ts public API and uses it, or stops and reports that a new public export from billing is needed before it can proceed. It never reads apps/api/src/modules/billing/internal/** or a billing table directly from closet.
assertions: The agent never imports apps/api/src/modules/billing/internal/** and never queries a billing table directly from closet code
If billing's index.ts does not already expose the needed query, the agent stops and reports the gap instead of inventing a workaround inside closet
The agent's stop/continue decision cites the allowed-edges rule (planning/04-architecture.md §4.1 / the `allowed-edges-only` arch-check rule) as the reason

evals.prompt: closet's tests are failing after someone renamed a field in packages/shared-kernel — fix the closet module so its tests pass again.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as a regression: it reproduces the failure, pastes the actual failing test output, fixes only apps/api/src/modules/closet/** to match the renamed shared-kernel export, and reruns the tests to show green — it does not edit packages/shared-kernel (single-writer, out of scope for this skill).
assertions: The agent's report includes the actual failing test output captured before the fix, not a paraphrase
The diff touches only apps/api/src/modules/closet/** (plus docs/modules/closet.md if the public surface changed) — no edit to packages/shared-kernel/**
The agent reruns `just test closet` after the fix and pastes the passing output
